newsitem.title: POLAND: Credit Suisse gets Polish advisory licence.
newsitem.headline: Credit Suisse gets Polish advisory licence.

text.p: Credit Suisse Investment Management (Polska) Ltd received an investment management and advisory licence from the Polish securities commission (KPN), it said in a statement on Wednesday.

The Polish firm, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Credit Suisse Bank with a share capital of 2.6 million zlotys, will offer money management and advisory services for clients in listed Polish equities and fixed income instruments.
The Credit Suisse Investment Management Group has invested $75 million in Polish companies in a foreign investors' fund it manages out of London, the statement said.
